_instructions: Score every hint for the pair it sits under. 'already_served' is context only: do not score it.

hints.explanation: The arcade crane game grabs prizes with a claw, and in Toy Story the little green aliens worship "the claw."

lines.ALIEN: Toy Story's three-eyed aliens chant "The claw!"
lines.CRANE: Claw machines are also called crane games.

hints.explanation: A limb is an arm or a leg, and a tree's big branches are called limbs too.

lines.BRANCH: A tree's large branches are its limbs, as in going out on a limb.

hints.explanation: A pouch is a small bag, and a mother kangaroo carries her joey in one.

lines.BAG: A pouch is a small bag or sack.
lines.KANGAROO: Kangaroo mothers carry their babies in a pouch.

hints.explanation: Donkey Kong collects bananas in the Nintendo games, and King Kong battles Godzilla in the movies.

lines.BANANA: Donkey Kong is famous for collecting and guarding bananas.
lines.GODZILLA: Godzilla vs. Kong pits the two giant monsters against each other.

hints.explanation: Barbenheimer was the 2023 double feature of Barbie and Oppenheimer, the film about the atomic bomb.

lines.BARBIE: Barbie was half of the Barbenheimer craze.
lines.BOMB: Oppenheimer tells the story of the atomic bomb.

hints.explanation: To charge an enemy is to assault it, and assault and battery is a pair of criminal charges.

lines.BATTERY: In law, battery is the partner of assault.
lines.CHARGE: A charge is an assault on the enemy, and assault is also a legal charge.

hints.explanation: Benjamin Button is the man who ages backwards, and "Benjamins" is slang for hundred-dollar bills with Ben Franklin on them.

lines.BILL: The $100 bill shows Benjamin Franklin, so the bills are nicknamed Benjamins.
lines.BUTTON: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button follows a man who ages in reverse.

hints.explanation: Veins carry blood back to the heart, and miners follow a vein of gold through rock.

lines.BLOOD: Veins carry blood back to your heart.
lines.GOLD: A vein of gold is a seam of ore running through rock.

hints.explanation: Lightning strikes as a bolt, and in the classic films a lightning storm brings Frankenstein's monster to life.

lines.BOLT: A single flash of lightning is called a bolt.
lines.FRANKENSTEIN: In the movies, Dr. Frankenstein harnesses lightning to animate his creature.

hints.explanation: In The Wizard of Oz, the Scarecrow wants a brain and the Tin Man wants a heart.

lines.BRAIN: The Scarecrow goes to Oz to ask for a brain.
lines.HEART: The Tin Man goes to Oz to ask for a heart.

hints.explanation: Glamping is glamorous camping, with luxury comforts like real beds in the tent.

lines.CAMP: Glamping is a fancy way to camp.
lines.LUXURY: Glamping brings luxury to the outdoors.

hints.explanation: A broken bone may need a cast, and actors heading on stage are told to break a leg.

lines.CAST: A bad break can leave you in a cast.
lines.STAGE: Break a leg is the good-luck wish before going on stage.

hints.explanation: A gauntlet is an armored glove, and throwing one down issues a challenge.

lines.CHALLENGE: To throw down the gauntlet is to issue a challenge.
lines.GLOVE: A gauntlet is a heavy protective glove.

hints.explanation: Baby chicks say "peep," and Little Bo Peep lost her sheep.

lines.CHICK: A chick's tiny call is a peep, as in Easter Peeps.
lines.SHEEP: Little Bo Peep has lost her sheep.

hints.explanation: Pi relates a circle's circumference to its diameter, and Pi Day is celebrated on March 14.

lines.CIRCLE: Pi is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.
lines.MARCH: March 14 (3/14) is celebrated as Pi Day.

hints.explanation: In The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe, children step through a wardrobe closet into Narnia, ruled by the White Witch.

lines.CLOSET: A wardrobe closet is the doorway to Narnia.
lines.WITCH: The White Witch keeps Narnia in endless winter.

hints.explanation: Italy is shaped like a boot, and you boot up a computer.

lines.COMPUTER: Starting a computer is called booting it.
lines.ITALY: Italy's map looks like a high-heeled boot.

hints.explanation: Frasier Crane is the psychiatrist who hosts a call-in radio show in the sitcom Frasier.

lines.CRANE: Dr. Frasier Crane gives his surname to this word.
lines.RADIO: Frasier hosts a radio advice show in Seattle.

hints.explanation: Cricket is played with a flat bat, and a vampire bat drinks blood.

lines.VAMPIRE: Some vampires in stories turn into bats, and vampire bats are real.

hints.explanation: A pentagon is a five-sided shape, and the Pentagon is the headquarters of the U.S. Department of Defense.

lines.DEFENSE: The Pentagon houses the Department of Defense.
lines.SHAPE: A pentagon is a five-sided shape.

hints.explanation: Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds is a Beatles song.

lines.DIAMOND: Lucy has diamonds in the song title too.
lines.SKY: Lucy is in the sky in the Beatles song.

hints.explanation: In one of film's most famous images, Marilyn Monroe's white dress billows up as a subway train passes beneath the grate she stands on.

lines.DRESS: Marilyn Monroe's white halter dress from The Seven Year Itch is iconic.
lines.SUBWAY: The breeze that lifts her dress comes from a subway train below the grate.

hints.explanation: Spock performs the Vulcan mind meld and has famous pointed ears.

lines.EAR: Spock's pointy ears are his signature look.
lines.MIND: Spock's mind meld links two minds.

hints.explanation: A clock has a face and hands.

lines.FACE: The front of a clock is its face.
lines.HAND: The hands point to the time.

hints.explanation: Old McDonald had a farm, and McDonald's is the world's best-known hamburger chain.
Tinder is the dating app where you get a match, and tinder is dry stuff that catches fire.

lines.FIRE: Tinder is kindling that helps start a fire.
lines.MATCH: On Tinder, two people who swipe right are a match.

hints.explanation: To frost a cake is to ice it, and icing is a hockey call for shooting the puck the length of the ice.

lines.FROST: Frost a cake and you have added icing.
lines.HOCKEY: Icing is a common hockey call.

hints.explanation: Ground chuck is ground beef, and a woodchuck (another name for a groundhog) stars in the tongue twister about how much wood it could chuck.

lines.GROUND: Ground chuck is a common cut of ground beef.
lines.WOOD: "How much wood would a woodchuck chuck?"

hints.explanation: Alice falls down the rabbit hole into Wonderland, and later steps through the looking-glass, a mirror.

lines.HOLE: Alice tumbles down a rabbit hole.
lines.MIRROR: In Through the Looking-Glass she climbs through a mirror.

hints.explanation: In Britain a car's trunk is called the boot, and Italy is shaped like a boot.

lines.TRUNK: The British word for a car trunk is the boot.

hints.explanation: Spaghetti is a long noodle, and Lady and the Tramp share a famous spaghetti kiss.

lines.KISS: The spaghetti kiss is the iconic scene from Lady and the Tramp.

hints.explanation: Patrick Star is SpongeBob's starfish best friend, and St. Patrick's Day falls in March.

lines.STAR: Patrick Star is SpongeBob's starfish buddy.

hints.explanation: Colonel Sanders guarded KFC's secret recipe, and a colonel is a military rank.

lines.MILITARY: A colonel is a senior military officer.
lines.SECRET: KFC's Colonel kept a secret blend of herbs and spices.

hints.explanation: Apple makes the Apple Watch, and New York is nicknamed the Big Apple.

lines.NEW YORK: New York City is the Big Apple.
lines.WATCH: The Apple Watch is Apple's smartwatch.

hints.explanation: Sails were traditionally made of canvas, and painters work on stretched canvas.

lines.PAINTING: Many paintings are made on canvas.
lines.SAIL: Canvas is the classic sail cloth.

hints.explanation: A right hook is a punch, and Captain Hook is the pirate villain of Peter Pan.

lines.PIRATE: Captain Hook is the most famous pirate in Neverland.
lines.RIGHT: A right hook is a classic boxing punch.

hints.explanation: A jigsaw is a picture puzzle, and it is also a power tool for cutting curves.

lines.TOOL: A jigsaw is a saw for cutting curved shapes.

hints.explanation: The Avengers are Marvel's famous superhero team, and to avenge something is to take revenge for it.

lines.REVENGE: Avenging a wrong means taking revenge for it.
lines.TEAM: The Avengers are Earth's mightiest superhero team.

hints.explanation: Cupid is the arrow-shooting symbol of Valentine's Day, and Cupid is one of Santa's reindeer.

lines.SANTA: Cupid pulls Santa's sleigh with the other reindeer.
lines.VALENTINE: Cupid is the symbol of Valentine's Day.

hints.explanation: White smoke from the Sistine Chapel signals that a new pope has been chosen.

lines.SMOKE: Smoke rises from the chapel when the vote ends.
lines.WHITE: White smoke means a new pope.

hints.explanation: Sonic means relating to sound, and Sonic the Hedgehog is a famous video game hero.

lines.SOUND: A sonic boom is a blast of sound.
lines.VIDEO GAME: Sonic the Hedgehog is a classic video game.

hints.explanation: The corona is the Sun's glowing outer atmosphere, and coronaviruses are named for their crown-like spikes.

lines.SUN: The Sun's corona is visible during a total eclipse.
lines.VIRUS: Coronaviruses look like they wear a crown, corona in Latin.

hints.explanation: Crews drill a well to reach water or oil, and a dentist drills a tooth before filling it.

lines.TOOTH: The dentist's drill is the sound everyone dreads.
lines.WELL: A drill bores a well deep into the ground.
